    ContinuumCloudEndpoint
    Actuator endpoint /actuator/continuum that surfaces the Cockroach Continuum control-plane state: whether the client is live or simulated, the visible clusters, and (when a VirtualClusterManager is present) the virtual clusters.

    Health indicator for the Cockroach Continuum Cloud control-plane connection.

    Factory for McpClient: returns a SimulatedMcpClient when the client is disabled or has no endpoint, otherwise an HttpMcpClient.

    VirtualCluster
    Tags the annotated method's work for a Cockroach vCluster so it is isolated on shared capacity.
    VirtualClusterAspect
    Applies Cockroach vCluster workload tagging to VirtualCluster-annotated methods: opens a transaction and issues SET LOCAL application_name for the vCluster name and, when Workload is present, SET LOCAL default_transaction_quality_of_service for the priority — then proceeds.
    VirtualClusterContext
    Thread-scoped Cockroach vCluster context for programmatic use, mirroring RegionContext.
    VirtualClusterContext.Binding
    Immutable vCluster binding: a name and (optionally) a workload priority.
    VirtualClusterContext.Scope
     
    VirtualClusterManager
    Manages the lifecycle of Cockroach virtual clusters over a SQL connection to a Continuum host cluster, using the CREATE / SHOW / DROP VIRTUAL CLUSTER statements.
    Workload
    Assigns a Cockroach vCluster workload priority to the annotated method, mapped to CockroachDB admission-control quality-of-service and applied as SET LOCAL default_transaction_quality_of_service for the transaction.
    Workload.Priority
    Workload priority classes and their CockroachDB QoS mapping.
